name: anthropic_web_search_errors_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: ANTHROPIC_WEB_SEARCH_ERRORS_20261107 — a web-search bridge failure carries its cause, not just its exception type (LQ-20261107-212).
Live 2026-11-07: every sampled cio-ask-material-events run over 24 h recorded web.anthropic as
"reason": "HTTPError" because search() kept only type(exc).__name__. These tests pin that an HTTPError
keeps its status (401/403/404/429/5xx are now separable), that a URLError keeps its socket reason, that
the response body is never echoed into the run row (it can quote the question or an auth error page),
that a bridge refusal code is unchanged, and that the success shape is unchanged. Hermetic: injected
transports only, no network, no bridge, no credit.
